title: Chapter 1: Greetings & Introductions
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Master the basics of saying hello and introducing yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 你好！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 你好！你叫什麼名字？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzì?
dialogue.en: Hello! What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我叫Anna，你呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Anna, nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: My name is Anna, and you?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.zh: 我是Ben。很高興認識你。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Ben. Hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ.
dialogue.en: I am Ben. Nice to meet you.

listening.text: 你好！我叫Anna。很高興認識你。

questions.q: What is the speaker's name?
What does '很高興認識你' mean?
How do you reply to '你好'?

reading.text: 大家好，我叫林大明。我是美國人。很高興認識你們。

questions.q: What is the person's name?
Where is the person from?
Who is he speaking to?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 你是哪國人？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.en: Which country are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 我是英國人。老師呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén. Lǎoshī ne?
dialogue.en: I am British. And you, teacher?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 我是台灣人。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì Táiwān rén.
dialogue.en: I am Taiwanese.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 台灣很漂亮。
dialogue.pinyin: Táiwān hěn piàoliang.
dialogue.en: Taiwan is very beautiful.

listening.text: 他是美國人，我是台灣人。我們是好朋友。

questions.q: Where is 'he' from?
Where is the speaker from?
What is their relationship?

reading.text: 我的朋友叫John，他是英國人。他現在在台灣學中文。他覺得台灣很漂亮。

questions.q: Where is John from?
What is John doing in Taiwan?
What does John think of Taiwan?

title: Chapter 2: Restaurant & Ordering
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn to order food and request the bill.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨，想吃什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín, xiǎng chī shénme?
dialogue.en: Welcome, what would you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要一碗牛肉麵。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào yī wǎn niúròu miàn.
dialogue.en: I want a bowl of beef noodles.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的，要不要小菜？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, yào bùyào xiǎocài?
dialogue.en: Okay, do you want any side dishes?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 不用了，謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Bùyòng le, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: No need, thank you.

listening.text: 老闆，我要兩個滷肉飯和一碗貢丸湯。外帶，謝謝。

questions.q: What did the person order?
options: Braised pork rice and meatball soup
questions.answer: Braised pork rice and meatball soup

questions.q: How many bowls of braised pork rice?
Are they eating in or taking out?

reading.text: 台灣的夜市很有名。我最喜歡吃臭豆腐和喝珍珠奶茶。雖然臭豆腐很臭，但是很好吃。

questions.q: What is famous in Taiwan?
What is the author's favorite food?
What does the author think of stinky tofu?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 老闆，買單！
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, mǎidān!
dialogue.en: Boss, check please!

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 好，一共是兩百塊。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, yīgòng shì liǎng bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Okay, altogether it's 200 NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 可以用LINE Pay嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ yòng LINE Pay ma?
dialogue.en: Can I use LINE Pay?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.zh: 可以，沒問題。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ, méi wèntí.
dialogue.en: Yes, no problem.

listening.text: 一共是一百五十元。收您五百元，找您三百五十元。謝謝。

questions.q: How much is the total?
How much did the customer give?
How much is the change?

reading.text: 這家餐廳不能刷卡，只能付現金。如果沒有現金，旁邊有一家便利商店可以領錢。

questions.q: Can you use a credit card at this restaurant?
How must you pay?
Where can you withdraw money?

title: Chapter 3: Shopping & Bargaining
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn numbers and how to ask for prices.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 請問，這個多少錢？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhège duōshǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how much is this?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 那個五百塊。
dialogue.pinyin: Nàge wǔ bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: That is 500 NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 太貴了！可以便宜一點嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài guì le! Kěyǐ piányí yīdiǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Too expensive! Can it be a bit cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.zh: 好啦，算你四百五十。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo la, suàn nǐ sì bǎi wǔshí.
dialogue.en: Alright, I'll give it to you for 450.

listening.text: 這件衣服一千元，那條褲子八百元。一共一千八百元。

questions.q: How much is the shirt?
How much are the pants?
What is the total?

reading.text: 我今天去買水果。蘋果一個三十元，香蕉一串五十元。我買了兩個蘋果和一串香蕉，一共花了一百一十元。

questions.q: How much is one apple?
How much is a bunch of bananas?
How many apples did the person buy?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我可以試穿這件外套嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shìchuān zhè jiàn wàitào ma?
dialogue.en: Can I try on this jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以，試衣間在那邊。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ, shìyījiān zài nàbiān.
dialogue.en: Yes, the fitting room is over there.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 這件有點小，有大一點的嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yǒudiǎn xiǎo, yǒu dà yīdiǎn de ma?
dialogue.en: This one is a bit small, do you have a bigger one?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有，我拿L號給你。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ ná L hào gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: Yes, I will get size L for you.

listening.text: 這雙鞋子很好看，可是太大了。我要試穿小一點的。

questions.q: What is the person talking about?
What is the problem?
What will they do next?

reading.text: 百貨公司現在有打折活動。買兩件衣服打八折。如果滿三千元，還可以送一個小禮物。

questions.q: Where is the event taking place?
What is the discount for buying two items?
How much do you need to spend to get a gift?

title: Chapter 4: Taking a Taxi
subtitle: Survival Mandarin
entry_description: Learn to give basic directions to a driver.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 你好，要去哪裡？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, yào qù nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Hello, where are you going?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 我要去台北車站。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Táiběi Chēzhàn.
dialogue.en: I want to go to Taipei Main Station.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。大概需要二十分鐘。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Dàgài xūyào èrshí fēnzhōng.
dialogue.en: Okay. It will take about 20 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: No problem, thank you.

listening.text: 司機先生，麻煩你到中山路一百號。我有點趕時間。

questions.q: Who is the speaker talking to?
Where do they want to go?
What is their current situation?

reading.text: 在台灣，除了在路上叫計程車，也可以用手機App叫車，例如Uber或是55688。用App叫車很方便，而且可以直接刷卡。

questions.q: What are two ways to get a taxi mentioned?
options: On the street or via App
questions.answer: On the street or via App

questions.q: What is an example of an App mentioned?
Why is using an App convenient?
options: You can pay by credit card directly
questions.answer: You can pay by credit card directly

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 前面那個路口右轉。
dialogue.pinyin: Qiánmiàn nàge lùkǒu yòuzhuǎn.
dialogue.en: Turn right at the intersection ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。要在這裡下車嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Yào zài zhèlǐ xiàchē ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want to get off here?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 對，就在便利商店門口停。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, jiù zài biànlì shāngdiàn ménkǒu tíng.
dialogue.en: Yes, just stop in front of the convenience store.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 到了，一共是兩百五十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Dào le, yīgòng shì liǎng bǎi wǔshí yuán.
dialogue.en: We're here, it's 250 NTD in total.

listening.text: 請直走，過兩個紅綠燈以後左轉。我的家就在右手邊。

questions.q: What is the first direction?
How many traffic lights to pass?
Which side is the house on?

reading.text: 如果你不知道怎麼走，可以開Google地圖給司機看。很多司機會看地圖，這樣比較不會迷路。

questions.q: What should you do if you don't know the way?
options: Show Google Maps to the driver
questions.answer: Show Google Maps to the driver

questions.q: Why is this helpful?
Who will look at the map?

title: Chapter 5: Convenience Store
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Navigate Taiwan's omnipresent convenience stores.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 需要袋子嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xūyào dàizi ma?
dialogue.en: Do you need a bag?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 不用，謝謝。這個便當可以微波嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Bùyòng, xièxiè. Zhège biàndāng kěyǐ wéibō ma?
dialogue.en: No, thank you. Can this bento be microwaved?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以，請稍等。要列印發票嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ, qǐng shāoděng. Yào lièyìn fāpiào ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, please wait a moment. Do you want to print the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 印出來，謝謝。
dialogue.pinyin: Yìn chūlái, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: Print it out, thanks.

listening.text: 我要一杯熱的拿鐵，中杯，無糖。然後我要取貨。

questions.q: What drink did the person order?
What size and sweetness?
What else are they doing?

reading.text: 台灣的便利商店非常方便。你可以買東西、繳水電費、寄包裹，還可以買高鐵票。而且大部分都是二十四小時營業的。

questions.q: What can you NOT do at a convenience store according to the text?
Can you buy train tickets there?
What are the store hours usually?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要拿包裹。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào ná bāoguǒ.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to pick up a package.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問手機末三碼？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn shǒujī mò sān mǎ?
dialogue.en: Okay, what are the last three digits of your phone number?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 八五二。
dialogue.pinyin: Bā wǔ èr.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 林先生對嗎？這是你的包裹。
dialogue.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng duì ma? Zhè shì nǐ de bāoguǒ.
dialogue.en: Mr. Lin, right? Here is your package.

listening.text: 請問有會員嗎？沒有的話可以報電話號碼集點。

questions.q: What is the clerk asking for?
If you don't have a card, what can you do?
Why provide the number?

reading.text: 取貨的時候，如果包裹已經付過錢了，店員會看你的身分證或是健保卡。如果還沒付錢，就可以直接付現金。非常簡單。

questions.q: What do you need if the package is already paid for?
What happens if it's not paid yet?
Is the process complicated?

title: Chapter 6: Bus & MRT
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Learn to use public transportation in Taiwan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問，去101大樓要坐哪一線？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù yī-líng-yī dàlóu yào zuò nǎ yī xiàn?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, which line should I take to get to the 101 building?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 請坐紅線，往象山的方向。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng zuò hóngxiàn, wǎng Xiàngshān de fāngxiàng.
dialogue.en: Please take the Red Line, towards Xiangshan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 在哪一站下車呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Zài nǎ yī zhàn xiàchē ne?
dialogue.en: At which station should I get off?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 在台北101站下車就可以了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài Táiběi yī-líng-yī zhàn xiàchē jiù kěyǐ le.
dialogue.en: Just get off at the Taipei 101 station.

listening.text: 各位旅客您好，往象山的列車即將進站。請在黃線後方排隊。

questions.q: Where is the train going?
What is the train about to do?
Where should passengers wait?

reading.text: 在台北坐捷運很方便。你只需一張悠遊卡。如果卡片沒錢了，可以在捷運站的加值機存錢，或者去便利商店加值。

questions.q: What do you need to ride the MRT?
What should you do if your card is out of money?
Where can you top up your card?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 請問這台公車有到故宮博物院嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè tái gōngchē yǒu dào Gùgōng Bówùyuàn ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the National Palace Museum?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 有，請上車。上車下車都要刷卡喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, qǐng shàngchē. Shàngchē xiàchē dōu yào shuākǎ ō.
dialogue.en: Yes, please get on. You need to swipe your card both when getting on and off.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.zh: 好的，大概要坐多久？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, dàgài yào zuò duōjiǔ?
dialogue.en: Okay, about how long will it take?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 大概十五分鐘就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàgài shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dialogue.en: It will take about 15 minutes.

listening.text: 下一站，中山國小。請由後門下車。

questions.q: What is the next stop?
Where should passengers exit from?
Is this a bus or a train?

reading.text: 在台灣坐公車，如果你要下車，記得按鈴。如果你在站牌等車，看到公車來了要招手，不然司機可能不會停。

questions.q: What should you do if you want to get off the bus?
What should you do when you see the bus coming while waiting?
What happens if you don't wave?

title: Chapter 7: Post Office
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Learn to send letters and packages at the post office.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想寄這個包裹到美國。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng jì zhège bāoguǒ dào Měiguó.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to send this package to America.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 裡面是什麼東西？有危險品嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǐmiàn shì shénme dōngxī? Yǒu wēixiǎnpǐn ma?
dialogue.en: What's inside? Any dangerous goods?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 裡面是衣服和零食。沒有危險品。
dialogue.pinyin: Lǐmiàn shì yīfú hé língshí. Méiyǒu wēixiǎnpǐn.
dialogue.en: Inside are clothes and snacks. No dangerous goods.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好，請放在秤上。一共是八百元。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, qǐng fàng zài chèng shàng. Yīgòng shì bā bǎi yuán.
dialogue.en: Okay, please put it on the scale. It's 800 NTD in total.

listening.text: 我要寄這封信，掛號到台中。一共是二十八元。

questions.q: What is the person sending?
What kind of mail service?
How much is it?

reading.text: 如果你不在家，郵差會留下一張領取通知單。你可以帶著通知單和身分證，去指定的郵局領包裹。

questions.q: What does the mailman leave if you aren't home?
What two things do you need to bring to pick up the package?
Where do you go to pick it up?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 請問，有賣郵票嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, yǒu mài yóupiào ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, do you sell stamps?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有。要寄哪裡的？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu. Yào jì nǎlǐ de?
dialogue.en: Yes. Where are you sending to?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要寄明信片到日本，三張。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào jì míngxìnpiàn dào Rìběn, sān zhāng.
dialogue.en: I want to send postcards to Japan, three of them.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 一張十元，三張共三十元。
dialogue.pinyin: Yī zhāng shí yuán, sān zhāng gòng sānshí yuán.
dialogue.en: Ten dollars each, so thirty dollars for three.

listening.text: 這封限時批信要在明天早上以前送到。麻煩幫我處理。

questions.q: What is the urgency level?
When does it need to arrive?
What is the object?

reading.text: 郵局除了寄信，還可以存錢和提錢。台灣的郵局提款機(ATM)很多，非常方便。

questions.q: What else can you do at a post office besides sending mail?
What machine is mentioned?
Are post office ATMs rare in Taiwan?

title: Chapter 8: Opening a Bank Account
subtitle: Daily Life
entry_description: Learn the terminology for banking and finances.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我想開一個新的戶頭。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kāi yīgè xīn de hùtóu.
dialogue.en: I would like to open a new account.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請給我你的護照和居留證。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng gěi wǒ nǐ de hùzhào hé jūliúzhèng.
dialogue.en: Okay, please give me your passport and ARC (Alien Resident Certificate).

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 給您。還需要印章嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Gěi nín. Hái xūyào yìnzhāng ma?
dialogue.en: Here you go. Do I also need a seal?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 如果您沒有印章，可以用簽名的。
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín méiyǒu yìnzhāng, kěyǐ yòng qiānmíng de.
dialogue.en: If you don't have a seal, you can use a signature.

listening.text: 請在這邊簽名，然後輸入你的六位數密碼。

questions.q: What should the person do first?
How many digits is the password?
What are they likely doing?
options: Opening an account or setting a PIN
questions.answer: Opening an account or setting a PIN

reading.text: 在台灣開戶，外國人通常需要雙證件，也就是護照和居留證。另外，有些銀行會要求你存入一千元作為開戶金。

questions.q: How many forms of ID are usually needed?
Which documents are mentioned?
How much money might you need to deposit initially?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我想把美金換成台幣。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ Měijīn huànchéng Táibì.
dialogue.en: I want to exchange US dollars for NTD.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請問要換多少？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Qǐngwèn yào huàn duōshǎo?
dialogue.en: No problem. How much do you want to exchange?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 五百塊美金。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔ bǎi kuài Měijīn.
dialogue.en: 500 US dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 今天的匯率是三十一點五。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì sānshíyī diǎn wǔ.
dialogue.en: Today's exchange rate is 31.5.

listening.text: 現在換錢需要手續費一百元。你可以接受嗎？

questions.q: How much is the service fee?
What is the fee for?
What is the clerk asking?

reading.text: 除了銀行，大百貨公司和機場也可以換錢。不過，銀行的匯率通常比較好，但是手續比較麻煩。

questions.q: Where else can you exchange money besides banks?
Where is the exchange rate usually better?
What is the downside of using a bank?

title: Chapter 9: Family & Relatives
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Talk about your family members and relationships.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì zǐmèi ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have siblings?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 我有兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng gè gēgē hé yīgè mèimei.
dialogue.en: I have two older brothers and one younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.zh: 哇，大家庭！你父母住在哪裡？
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, dà jiātíng! Nǐ fùmǔ zhù zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Wow, a big family! Where do your parents live?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 他們住在加拿大。
dialogue.pinyin: Tāmen zhù zài Jiānádà.
dialogue.en: They live in Canada.

listening.text: 我的家有五個人：爸爸、媽媽、姊姊、弟弟和我。

questions.q: How many people are in the family?
Who is the oldest sibling mentioned?
Is the speaker an only child?

reading.text: 這是我的全家福。照片裡有我的爺爺和奶奶。他們今年都八十歲了，但是身體很健康。

questions.q: What is '全家福'?
Who is in the photo?
How is their health?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 你結婚了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ jiéhūn le ma?
dialogue.en: Are you married?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 我還沒結婚，我現在有女朋友。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi jiéhūn, wǒ xiànzài yǒu nǚ péngyǒu.
dialogue.en: I'm not married yet, I have a girlfriend now.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.zh: 你女朋友也是外國人嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ péngyǒu yěshì wàiguórén ma?
dialogue.en: Is your girlfriend also a foreigner?

dialogue.speaker: Self
dialogue.zh: 不，她是台灣人。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù, tā shì Táiwān rén.
dialogue.en: No, she is Taiwanese.

listening.text: 我哥哥去年結婚了，他現在有一個可愛的女兒。

questions.q: When did the brother get married?
Does he have children?
Who is married?

reading.text: 在台灣，家庭觀念很重要。每到農曆新年，大家都會回家跟家人吃團圓飯。這是一個非常熱鬧的節日。

questions.q: Is family concept important in Taiwan?
What do people do during Lunar New Year?
options: Eat a reunion dinner (團圓飯) with family
questions.answer: Eat a reunion dinner (團圓飯) with family

questions.q: What is the atmosphere of the festival?

title: Chapter 10: Introducing Friends
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Learn to introduce your friends and acquaintances.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.zh: 大家請看，這是我最好的朋友，David。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàjiā qǐng kàn, zhè shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, David.
dialogue.en: Everyone look, this is my best friend, David.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 你好，David！很高興見到你。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, David! Hěn gāoxìng jiàn dào nǐ.
dialogue.en: Hello, David! Nice to see you.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興見到大家。這是我的一點心意。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng jiàn dào dàjiā. Zhè shì wǒ de yīdiǎn xīnyì.
dialogue.en: I'm also very happy to meet everyone. This is a small gift from me (a token of appreciation).

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，來，請坐！
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè nǐ, lái, qǐng zuò!
dialogue.en: Thank you, come, please sit!

listening.text: 他是我的大學同學，現在在一家科技公司上班。

questions.q: How do they know each other?
Where does he work?
What is his job status?

reading.text: 去台灣人家裡作客的時候，通常會帶一點禮物，例如水果或是禮盒。進門的時候，記得要換室內拖鞋。

questions.q: What should you bring when visiting a Taiwanese person's home?
What should you do when entering the house?
What is an example of a common gift?

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 你的新室友怎麼樣？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de xīn shìyǒu zěnmeyàng?
dialogue.en: How is your new roommate?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 他人很好，很幽默，也很愛乾淨。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā rén hěn hǎo, hěn yōumò, yě hěn ài gānjìng.
dialogue.en: He's a great guy, very humorous, and very clean.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。他有什麼愛好嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà tài hǎo le. Tā yǒu shéme àihào ma?
dialogue.en: That's great. Does he have any hobbies?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 他很喜歡彈吉他和打籃球。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān tán jítā hé dǎ lánqiú.
dialogue.en: He likes playing the guitar and basketball.

listening.text: 我認識她很久了，她是一個很溫柔的人，也很喜歡幫助別人。

questions.q: How long has the speaker known her?
What is her personality like?
What does she like to do?

reading.text: 在台灣，如果你想交朋友，可以參加一些興趣社團，或是去語言交換聚會。台灣人通常對外國人很友善。

questions.q: Where can you make friends in Taiwan?
Are Taiwanese people generally friendly to foreigners?
What is '語言交換'?

title: Chapter 11: Asking for Directions
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Learn to navigate and ask for directions in a city.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問，去國立博物館要怎麼走？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù Guólì Bówùguǎn yào zěnme zǒu?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the National Museum?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 沿著這條路直走，到第二個紅綠燈右轉。
dialogue.pinyin: Yánzhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu, dào dì èr gè hónglǜdēng yòuzhuǎn.
dialogue.en: Go straight along this road, and turn right at the second traffic light.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 右轉以後呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Yòuzhuǎn yǐhòu ne?
dialogue.en: And after turning right?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 再走五分鐘就到了，博物館就在你的左手邊。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le, bówùguǎn jiù zài nǐ de zuǒshǒubiān.
dialogue.en: Walk for another five minutes and you'll be there; the museum will be on your left side.

listening.text: 這裡離捷運站很近。你過馬路，看到那家咖啡店，捷運站就在咖啡店旁邊。

questions.q: Is the MRT station far?
What landmark should the person look for?
Where is the MRT station relative to the landmark?

reading.text: 在城市裡，如果你迷路了，除了問路人，也可以找便利商店或是警察局。台灣的警察通常很熱心，會幫你指路。

questions.q: What should you do if you are lost?
options: Ask a pedestrian, or go to a convenience store/police station
questions.answer: Ask a pedestrian, or go to a convenience store/police station

questions.q: Who is mentioned as being 'enthusiastic/helpful' (熱心)?
Will the police help you with directions?

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 請問這附近有藥局嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè fùjìn yǒu yàojú ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 有，在那家超市對面。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, zài nà jiā chāoshì duìmiàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, opposite that supermarket.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.zh: 走路可以到嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Zǒulù kěyǐ dào ma?
dialogue.en: Can I get there by walking?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.zh: 有點遠，走路要十五分鐘。你可以騎YouBike。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒudiǎn yuǎn, zǒulù yào shíwǔ fēnzhōng. Nǐ kěyǐ qí YouBike.
dialogue.en: It's a bit far, it takes 15 minutes to walk. You can ride a YouBike.

listening.text: 這附近沒有停車位，你可能要停到兩個街區以外的停車場。

questions.q: What is missing nearby?
Where should the person park?
options: Two blocks away at a parking lot
questions.answer: Two blocks away at a parking lot

questions.q: Is parking easy there?

reading.text: YouBike是台灣很受歡迎的公共自行車系統。只要用悠遊卡註冊，就可以在很多站點借車和還車。前三十分鐘通常很便宜。

questions.q: What is YouBike?
How do you register to use it?
How is the pricing for the first 30 minutes?

title: Chapter 12: Travel & Hotel
subtitle: People & Places
entry_description: Learn phrases for traveling and staying at hotels.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨，請問有預約嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn yǒu yùyuē ma?
dialogue.en: Welcome, do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 有，我姓王，預約了兩晚。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ xìng Wáng, yùyuē le liǎng wǎn.
dialogue.en: Yes, my surname is Wang, I booked for two nights.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的，請出示您的證件。這是您的房卡。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng chūshì nín de zhèngjiàn. Zhè shì nín de fángkǎ.
dialogue.en: Okay, please show your ID. Here is your room card.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問早餐在哪裡吃？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Qǐngwèn zǎocān zài nǎlǐ chī?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Where is breakfast served?

listening.text: 退房時間是早上十一點。如果您需要寄放行李，可以告訴櫃檯。

questions.q: What time is check-out?
What can you do with your luggage?
options: Store it at the counter (寄放行李)
questions.answer: Store it at the counter (寄放行李)

questions.q: Who should you talk to for luggage storage?

reading.text: 這家飯店的設施很棒，有游泳池、健身房，還有免費的Wi-Fi。頂樓的餐廳風景很好，可以看到整個城市的夜景。

questions.q: What facilities are mentioned?
Where is the restaurant with a good view?
What can you see from the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 我想參加明天的太魯閣一日遊。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā míngtiān de Tàilǔgé yī rì yóu.
dialogue.en: I want to join tomorrow's Taroko Gorge one-day tour.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，早上八點在飯店大廳集合。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, zǎoshàng bā diǎn zài fàndiàn dàtīng jíhé.
dialogue.en: No problem, gather in the hotel lobby at 8 AM.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.zh: 費用包含午餐嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Fèiyòng bāohán wǔcān ma?
dialogue.en: Does the fee include lunch?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 有的，包含午餐和門票。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu de, bāohán wǔcān hé ménpiào.
dialogue.en: Yes, it includes lunch and entrance tickets.

listening.text: 如果你要去阿里山看日出，一定要記得帶厚外套，因為山上很冷。

questions.q: Where is the person going?
What should they bring?
Why bring that item?

reading.text: 台灣有很多美麗的風景區。東部有山有海，南部很熱情，北部很方便。無論你去哪裡，都可以體驗到不同的文化。

questions.q: What is the scenery like in the east?
What is the characteristic of the north?
Can you experience different cultures in Taiwan?

title: Chapter 13: Job Interview
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Prepare for a job interview in a Mandarin-speaking environment.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 請你先做一下自我介紹。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān zuò yīxià zìwǒ jièshào.
dialogue.en: Please start with a self-introduction.

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 您好，我叫Mark，畢業於國立大學。
dialogue.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ jiào Mark, bìyè yú Guólì Dàxué.
dialogue.en: Hello, my name is Mark, and I graduated from National University.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 你有相關的工作經驗嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu xiāngguān de gōngzuò jīngyàn ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have relevant work experience?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我有三年的行銷經驗，會說中文和英文。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sān nián de hángxiāo jīngyàn, huì shuō Zhōngwén hé Yīngwén.
dialogue.en: I have three years of marketing experience and can speak Chinese and English.

listening.text: 我們正在尋找一位有責任心、團隊合作能力強的人才。

questions.q: What quality is the company looking for?
What kind of ability is mentioned?
Is the company looking for talent?

reading.text: 面試的時候，服裝要整齊，態度要誠懇。除了回答問題，你也可以問關於公司發展和福利的問題。

questions.q: How should you dress for an interview?
What should your attitude be like?
Can you ask questions to the interviewer?
options: Yes, about company development and benefits
questions.answer: Yes, about company development and benefits

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 你覺得你最大的優點是什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ juédé nǐ zuìdà de yōudiǎn shì shénme?
dialogue.en: What do you think is your greatest strength?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 我學習很快，而且做事很細心。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí hěn kuài, érqiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn.
dialogue.en: I learn very fast and am very meticulous in my work.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.zh: 那缺點呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà quēdiǎn ne?
dialogue.en: And your weaknesses?

dialogue.speaker: Applicant
dialogue.zh: 有時候我太追求完美，所以壓力比較大。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒushíhòu wǒ tài zhuīqiú wánměi, suǒyǐ yālì bǐjiào dà.
dialogue.en: Sometimes I pursue perfection too much, so I feel more pressure.

listening.text: 如果你被錄取了，什麼時候可以開始上班？

questions.q: What is the condition mentioned?
What does the interviewer want to know?
Is the interview over?

reading.text: 這份工作的上班時間是早上九點到下午六點，週休二日。薪水會根據你的表現進行調整。

questions.q: What are the working hours?
How many rest days per week?
What determines the salary adjustment?

title: Chapter 14: Office Talk
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Communicate effectively with colleagues in an office setting.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你可以幫我印這份文件嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ yìn zhè fèn wénjiàn ma?
dialogue.en: Sorry, can you help me print this document?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，要印幾份？
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, yào yìn jǐ fèn?
dialogue.en: No problem, how many copies?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.zh: 三份就好，謝謝。還有，印表機在哪？
dialogue.pinyin: Sān fèn jiù hǎo, xièxiè. Háiyǒu, yìngbiǎojī zài nǎ?
dialogue.en: Three copies is fine, thanks. Also, where is the printer?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.zh: 就在飲水機旁邊。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiù zài yǐnshuǐjī pángbiān.
dialogue.en: It's right next to the water dispenser.

listening.text: 下午三點在第一會議室開會，請大家準時參加。

questions.q: What time is the meeting?
Where is the meeting?
What is the requirement?

reading.text: 在辦公室，團隊溝通非常重要。如果有問題，應該主動跟主管或是同事討論，以免影響工作進度。

questions.q: What is important in the office?
What should you do if there's a problem?
What is the risk of not communicating?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 你寄電子郵件給客戶了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ jì diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi kèhù le ma?
dialogue.en: Did you send the email to the client?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我正在確認報價單。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái méi, wǒ zhèngzài quèrèn bàojiàdān.
dialogue.en: Not yet, I'm currently confirming the quotation.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 確認完就趕快寄出去，他們在等。
dialogue.pinyin: Quèrèn wán jiù gǎnkuài jì chūqù, tāmen zài děng.
dialogue.en: Once confirmed, send it out quickly; they are waiting.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 好的，我十分鐘內寄出。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ shí fēnzhōng nèi jì chū.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll send it within ten minutes.

listening.text: 王經理，這是我這禮拜的工作報告，請您查收。

questions.q: Who is the speaker talking to?
What is being handed over?
What is the purpose?

reading.text: 寫商務郵件時，主旨要明確，內容要簡潔。最後記得要寫上自己的聯絡資訊，方便對方回覆。

questions.q: How should the subject line be?
What should the content be like?
What should be included at the end?

title: Chapter 15: School & Classes
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Common phrases and situations in an educational environment.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 你這學期選了什麼課？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqí xuǎn le shénme kè?
dialogue.en: What classes did you choose this semester?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 我選了中級漢語和中國文化。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎn le zhōngjí Hànyǔ hé Zhōngguó wénhuà.
dialogue.en: I chose Intermediate Chinese and Chinese Culture.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.zh: 聽說文化課的作業很多，是真的嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Tīngshuō wénhuà kè de zuòyè hěnduō, shì zhēn de ma?
dialogue.en: I heard the culture class has a lot of homework, is it true?

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 對，但是老師教得很好。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, dànshì lǎoshī jiāo de hěn hǎo.
dialogue.en: Yes, but the teacher teaches very well.

listening.text: 明天的中文考試延期到下禮拜五了。

questions.q: What event was postponed?
When is the new date?
Was the exam cancelled?

reading.text: 圖書館是讀書的好地方。裡面很安靜，有很多參考書。如果你要借書，需要帶學生證。

questions.q: What is the library good for?
What is the environment like?
What do you need to borrow books?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 老師，這個字怎麼讀？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎoshī, zhège zì zěnme dú?
dialogue.en: Teacher, how do I read this character?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這個字讀'聽'，意思是'to listen'。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège zì dú 'tīng', yìsi shì 'to listen'.
dialogue.en: This character is read as 'ting', it means 'to listen'.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。可以請您再說一遍嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè lǎoshī. Kěyǐ qǐng nín zài shuō yībiàn ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher. Can you please say it one more time?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，聽——。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, tīng——.
dialogue.en: No problem, tīng——.

listening.text: 請大家翻到課本第五十頁，我們今天看第三課。

questions.q: What page should students open to?
Which lesson are they looking at?
What is the object mentioned?

reading.text: 如果你缺席了，一定要跟老師請假。你可以寫信或是親自去辦公室說明原因。

questions.q: What should you do if you are absent?
What are two ways to notify the teacher?
options: Write an email or go in person
questions.answer: Write an email or go in person

questions.q: Should you give a reason?

title: Chapter 16: Renting an Apartment
subtitle: Work & Study
entry_description: Learn the essentials for finding and renting a home.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想看這間房。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng kàn zhè jiān fáng.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to see this room.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。這間採光很好，還有陽台。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Zhè jiān cǎiguāng hěn hǎo, hái yǒu yángtái.
dialogue.en: No problem. This one has great natural light and a balcony.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.zh: 租金包含管理費嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Zūjīn bāohán guǎnlǐfèi ma?
dialogue.en: Does the rent include the management fee?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 不包含，但是包含網路費。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù bāohán, dànshì bāohán wǎnglùfèi.
dialogue.en: It doesn't, but it includes the internet fee.

listening.text: 押金是兩個月，租約至少要簽一年。

questions.q: How much is the deposit?
What is the minimum lease term?
What is '押金'?

reading.text: 租房子的時候，要看清楚合約內容。特別是關於修繕和退租的規定。如果有問題，一定要當場提出。

questions.q: What should you read clearly when renting?
What specific regulations are mentioned?
When should you raise questions?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.zh: 我明天要搬進去了，鑰匙在哪？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào bān jìnqù le, yàoshi zài nǎ?
dialogue.en: I'm moving in tomorrow, where are the keys?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 我會放在一樓的管理室。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ huì fàng zài yī lóu de guǎnlǐshì.
dialogue.en: I'll leave them in the management office on the first floor.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。如果家具壞了怎麼辦？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Rúguǒ jiājù huài le zěnmebàn?
dialogue.en: Thank you. What if the furniture is broken?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 請拍照傳給我，我會找人修。
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng pāizhào chuán gěi wǒ, wǒ huì zhǎo rén xiū.
dialogue.en: Please take a photo and send it to me, I'll find someone to fix it.

listening.text: 這棟大樓有垃圾集中處理，你不用追垃圾車。

questions.q: Does the building have a centralized garbage area?
What do you NOT need to do?
Is this convenient?

reading.text: 在台灣，垃圾分類非常嚴格。你需要把垃圾分成：一般垃圾、資源回收和廚餘。如果不遵守規定，可能會被罰款。

questions.q: Is garbage sorting strict in Taiwan?
What are the three categories mentioned?
options: General, recycling, food waste (一般、回收、廚餘)
questions.answer: General, recycling, food waste (一般、回收、廚餘)

questions.q: What happens if you don't follow the rules?

title: Chapter 17: Hobbies & Interests
subtitle: Social Communication
entry_description: Discuss your favorite activities and interests.

lessons.title: What do you like to do?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你週末通常做什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò tōngcháng zuò shénme?
dialogue.en: What do you usually do on weekends?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡爬山，也喜歡看電影。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān páshān, yě xǐhuān kàn diànyǐng.
dialogue.en: I like hiking and also watching movies.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我也愛爬山！下禮拜要一起去嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě ài páshān! Xià lǐbài yào yīqǐ qù ma?
dialogue.en: I love hiking too! Want to go together next week?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們去陽明山吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒmen qù Yángmíngshān ba.
dialogue.en: Sure, let's go to Yangmingshan.

listening.text: 我的興趣是攝影。我喜歡去不同的景點拍漂亮的照片。

questions.q: What is the speaker's hobby?
What does the speaker like to take photos of?
Does the speaker travel to different places?

reading.text: 每個人都有不同的愛好。有些人喜歡室內活動，例如閱讀或是聽音樂；有些人喜歡室外活動，例如旅遊或是跑步。愛好可以讓生活更有趣。

questions.q: What is '愛好'?
What is an example of an indoor activity mentioned?
What can hobbies do for life?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡聽什麼樣的音樂？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān tīng shénmeyàng de yīnyuè?
dialogue.en: What kind of music do you like listening to?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡流行音樂，特別是K-pop。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān liúxíng yīnyuè, tèbié shì K-pop.
dialogue.en: I like pop music the most, especially K-pop.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我也喜歡！那電影呢？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuān! Nà diànyǐng ne?
dialogue.en: I like it too! What about movies?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我比較喜歡看恐怖片，很刺激。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān kàn kǒngbùpiàn, hěn cìjī.
dialogue.en: I prefer watching horror movies; they are very exciting.

listening.text: 這個樂團很有名。他們的演唱會門票一下子就賣完了。

questions.q: What is famous?
What happened to the concert tickets?
Is the band popular?

reading.text: 現在很多人喜歡在影音平台上追劇。無論是韓劇、日劇還是美劇，只要有網路，隨時隨地都可以看。

questions.q: What do many people like to do now?
What is needed to watch these dramas?
When can you watch them?

title: Chapter 18: Sports & Health
subtitle: Social Communication
entry_description: Talk about staying fit and playing sports.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 你最近怎麼變瘦了？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnme biàn shòu le?
dialogue.en: How come you've gotten thinner lately?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 因為我每天都去健身房運動。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ měitiān dōu qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng.
dialogue.en: Because I go to the gym to exercise every day.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.zh: 你都做什麼運動？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ dōu zuò shénme yùndòng?
dialogue.en: What exercises do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.zh: 我先跑步半小時，然後重訓。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiān pǎobù bàn xiǎoshí, ránhòu zhòngxùn.
dialogue.en: I run for half an hour first, then do weight training.

listening.text: 為了健康，我們應該多吃蔬菜水果，少喝含糖飲料。

questions.q: What is the goal?
What should we eat more of?
What should we drink less of?

reading.text: 保持運動習慣對身體很好。如果你不喜歡去健身房，也可以去公園散步或是騎腳踏車。最重要的是要持之以恆。

questions.q: What is good for the body?
What are two outdoor alternatives to the gym?
options: Walking in the park or cycling
questions.answer: Walking in the park or cycling

questions.q: What is the most important thing?

dialogue.speaker: Fan A
dialogue.zh: 今晚有棒球比賽，你要看嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Jīnwǎn yǒu bàngqiú bǐsài, nǐ yào kàn ma?
dialogue.en: There's a baseball game tonight, do you want to watch?

dialogue.speaker: Fan B
dialogue.zh: 要！哪兩隊在打？
dialogue.pinyin: Yào! Nǎ liǎng duì zài dǎ?
dialogue.en: Yes! Which two teams are playing?

dialogue.speaker: Fan A
dialogue.zh: 中信兄弟對統一獅。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhōngxìn Xiōngdì duì Tǒngyī Shī.
dialogue.en: Chinatrust Brothers versus Uni-Lions.

dialogue.speaker: Fan B
dialogue.zh: 我支持兄弟隊，他們最強了！
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhīchí Xiōngdì duì, tāmen zuì qiáng le!
dialogue.en: I support the Brothers; they are the strongest!

listening.text: 全壘打！這球飛得好遠啊！

questions.q: What just happened?
How did the ball fly?
Which sport is this likely from?

reading.text: 棒球是台灣的'國球'。很多人喜歡去現場看比賽，感受熱鬧的氣氛。啦啦隊的表演也是比賽的一大重點。

questions.q: What is the 'national sport' of Taiwan?
Why do people like going to the games in person?
What is another major highlight of the games?

title: Chapter 19: Doctor's Visit
subtitle: Social Communication
entry_description: Communicate your symptoms and understand a doctor's advice.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.zh: 王先生，請進。哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng, qǐng jìn. Nǎlǐ bù shūfú?
dialogue.en: Mr. Wang, please come in. What's bothering you?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 我頭痛、喉嚨痛，還有點發燒。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ tóutòng, hóulóng tòng, hái yǒudiǎn fāshāo.
dialogue.en: I have a headache, a sore throat, and a bit of a fever.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 來，我幫你量一下體溫。感冒了。
dialogue.pinyin: Lái, wǒ bāng nǐ liáng yīxià tǐwēn. Gǎnmào le.
dialogue.en: Come, I'll take your temperature. You have a cold.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 需要打針嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xūyào dǎzhēn ma?
dialogue.en: Do I need an injection?

listening.text: 這個藥一天吃三次，飯後吃。記得多喝水、多休息。

questions.q: How many times a day should the medicine be taken?
When should the medicine be taken?
What else should the patient do?
options: Drink water and rest (多喝水休息)
questions.answer: Drink water and rest (多喝水休息)

reading.text: 在台灣看醫生很方便。如果你有健保卡，掛號費和醫藥費通常都很便宜。一般的感冒可以去附近的診所看就好。

questions.q: What card makes seeing a doctor cheaper in Taiwan?
Are medical costs generally expensive with the card?
Where should you go for a common cold?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 我的牙齒好痛，好像蛀牙了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ de yáchǐ hǎo tòng, hǎoxiàng zhùyá le.
dialogue.en: My tooth hurts so much; I think I have a cavity.

dialogue.speaker: Dentist
dialogue.zh: 我看看。這顆牙要補一下。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ kànkàn. Zhè kē yá yào bǔ yīxià.
dialogue.en: Let me see. This tooth needs a filling.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.zh: 會很痛嗎？我很怕看牙醫。
dialogue.pinyin: Huì hěn tòng ma? Wǒ hěn pà kàn yáyī.
dialogue.en: Will it hurt? I'm very afraid of seeing the dentist.

dialogue.speaker: Dentist
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我會先打麻醉。
dialogue.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, wǒ huì xiān dǎ mázuì.
dialogue.en: Don't worry, I'll apply anesthesia first.

listening.text: 你應該每半年檢查一次牙齒，這樣才能保護牙齒健康。

questions.q: How often should you check your teeth?
What is the goal of the check-up?
Is regular check-up recommended?

reading.text: 刷牙的方式很重要。除了早晚刷牙，還應該使用牙線來清潔牙縫。少吃甜食也能預防蛀牙。

questions.q: What else should you use besides a toothbrush?
When should you brush your teeth?
How can you prevent cavities?

title: Chapter 20: Dating & Relationships
subtitle: Social Communication
entry_description: Navigate social relationships and dating in Mandarin.

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.zh: 你這週六有空嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhè zhōuliù yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: Are you free this Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Girl
dialogue.zh: 有啊，有什麼事嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu a, yǒu shéme shì ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, what's up?

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.zh: 我想請你去看電影，然後一起吃晚餐。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ qù kàn diànyǐng, ránhòu yīqǐ chī wǎncān.
dialogue.en: I'd like to invite you to a movie, and then have dinner together.

dialogue.speaker: Girl
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我很期待！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ hěn qīdài!
dialogue.en: Sure, I'm looking forward to it!

listening.text: 我很喜歡他的個性，因為他很溫柔也很貼心。

questions.q: What does the speaker like about him?
What are the two adjectives used?
How does the speaker feel about him?

reading.text: 初次約會時，選擇一個輕鬆的地方比較好，例如咖啡廳或是公園。穿著也要適當，給對方留下好印象。

questions.q: Where is a good place for a first date?
options: A relaxed place like a cafe or park
questions.answer: A relaxed place like a cafe or park

questions.q: Why is dressing appropriately important?
What is '印象'?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 情人節快到了，你打算怎麼過？
dialogue.pinyin: Qíngrénjié kuài dào le, nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme guò?
dialogue.en: Valentine's Day is coming, how do you plan to spend it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我訂了一家浪漫的餐廳，還買了玫瑰花。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dìng le yī jiā làngmàn de chāntīng, hái mǎi le méiguīhuā.
dialogue.en: I booked a romantic restaurant and bought roses.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 哇，真浪漫！你女朋友一定很開心。
dialogue.pinyin: Wa, zhēn làngmàn! Nǐ nǚ péngyǒu yīdìng hěn kāixīn.
dialogue.en: Wow, so romantic! Your girlfriend will definitely be happy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 希望如此，我還有準備一個小驚喜。
dialogue.pinyin: Xīwàng rúcǐ, wǒ hái yǒu zhǔnbèi yīgè xiǎo jīngxǐ.
dialogue.en: I hope so; I also prepared a small surprise.

listening.text: 他們下個月要結婚了，我們一起去參加婚禮吧。

questions.q: What is happening next month?
Who is getting married?
What will the speaker do?

reading.text: 在台灣，除了西洋情人節，還有七夕情人節。很多情侶會一起看煙火或是去約會。這是一個充滿愛的節日。

questions.q: How many Valentine's Days are mentioned?
What is '七夕'?
What do couples do according to the text?
options: Watch fireworks or go on dates
questions.answer: Watch fireworks or go on dates
